description: Dry run: previews changing a projects showcase's details to the full list you pass and returns a plain-text summary, with changes that remove project values marked destructive. Use it whenever the user wants to add, rename, reorder, or remove project details; nothing is saved. Always read the current details with get_project_details right before changing them: teammates edit them in the dashboard, so an earlier copy may be stale. Never revert or overwrite their edits. Send the full list in order: existing details with their key and option values exactly as read (only labels, units, and option labels can be renamed; keys and types never change), new details and options without a key or value. Leaving one out removes it. Show the summary to the user before apply_project_details.

expectedVersion.description: The version you read with get_project_details, e.g. 3.

fields.description: Every detail, in order: existing ones with their key (and option values) as read, new ones without, e.g. [{ "key": "location", "label": "Location", "type": "short_text" }, { "label": "Square footage", "type": "number", "unit": "sq ft", "showOnCard": true }].

key.description: Existing details: always their current key (from get_project_details), e.g. "square_footage". New details: omit; it's derived from the label.

label.description: Shown on project pages, e.g. "Square footage".
Shown on the website, e.g. "Custom Home".

value.description: Existing options: their current value exactly as read, e.g. "custom-home". New options: omit; it's derived from the label.

options.description: select only, in order, e.g. [{ "label": "Custom Home" }, { "label": "Remodel" }].

showOnCard.description: Also show it on the projects index cards (at most 2 details), e.g. true.

type.description: short_text, number, select, year, date, or link; an existing detail keeps its type, e.g. "number".

unit.description: number only: shown after the value, which stays a plain number, e.g. "sq ft".

showcaseId.description: Projects showcase id from list_showcases, e.g. "0190f5c2-7b1e-7c3a-9d2f-1a2b3c4d5e6f".

name: plan_project_details
title: Plan project details
